authority: CEO R335-A — formal portfolio ontology transition. 5-slot → 15-package.

historical_program.ontology: 5 invention slots (R6 Passive Rescue, Adaptive/Sensing eShunt, Controlled CNS Therapeutic, CNS/Lifecycle Intelligence, Slot 5)
historical_program.status: SUPERSEDED — historical lineage preserved. Not deleted (Article XI). This was the R258-era program structure.
historical_program.reason: CEO R275 STRATEGIC SHIFT from patent-examiner to technology-company. Program restructured from 5 invention slots to 15 technology packages. The 5-slot structure described a different program objective (world-class inventions via patent gates). The 15-package structure describes technology-transfer packages for buyer evaluation.

current_program.definition: A technology package is a credible, inspectable, reproducible technology opportunity that a real company can evaluate, license, build, acquire, or commission the decisive experiment for.
current_program.article_XXXV_completion: 0/15 — no candidate has completed the full closed-loop (discovery → attack → simulate → experiment → ingestion → model update → next experiment → dossier)

lineage.note: The 15-package portfolio evolved from the 5-slot program. P-01 corresponds to the Adaptive/Sensing eShunt slot. P-04 corresponds to the Controlled CNS Therapeutic slot. The 5-slot structure is the ancestor; the 15-package structure is the current program. Both are preserved in the repository.

mapping.Slot_1_R6_Passive_Rescue: Evolved into P-01 (Predictive Occlusion-Isolation) — different mechanism but same problem space
mapping.Slot_2_Adaptive_Sensing: Evolved into P-15 (Self-Powered Sensing) + P-16 (NIR Photovoltaic)
mapping.Slot_3_Controlled_CNS_Therapeutic: Evolved into P-04 (Catalytic Aβ) + P-12 (Tau Clearance) + P-20 (Glycan Immune Tolerance)
mapping.Slot_4_CNS_Lifecycle_Intelligence: Evolved into P-13 (Neuromorphic Predictor) + P-02 (Adaptive Valve)
mapping.Slot_5: Was empty in 5-slot program. Filled by P-09 (Chemical ICP Transduction), P-10 (Phase-Change Valve), P-11 (Phage Anti-Biofilm), P-21 (UWB Position), P-22 (Catheter Navigation) in 15-package program

qualification_criteria.what_qualifies_as_technology_package: A candidate enters the 15-package portfolio when it has: (1) defined mechanism, (2) executable computational model, (3) defined buyer problem, (4) decisive experiment specified, (5) pass/fail/ambiguous rules, (6) cost estimate, (7) buyer action. It does NOT need physical validation to be a package — it needs to be evaluable.
qualification_criteria.what_does_NOT_qualify: Cemetery candidates (excluded). Discovery programs without a defined mechanism (P-09 is borderline — has architecture but no molecule). Candidates that haven't passed admission gates.
qualification_criteria.completion_standard: Article XXXV: a package is COMPLETE when the full closed loop exists (discovery → attack → simulate → experiment → ingestion → model update → next experiment). Currently 0/15 meet this standard. 13/15 are package-ready (evaluable) but not loop-complete.
